_comment: EXAMPLE / TEST FIXTURE — not an authorization. scope.json is the written authorization and is gitignored because it names real targets. tools/ensure-test-scope.js copies this file to scope.json when scope.json is absent, so that `npm test` works on a fresh clone: the offline tests need loopback, and the scope-guard is fail-closed without it.
